**Tree-cover loss was detected, but the evidence does not establish whether the forest was cleared.**

In 2023, about 0.7 hectares of tree cover were lost on the 58.1-hectare property, or 1.2% of its area. The affected area was mapped as forest in 2020. A 2021 national map classified 0.4 hectares of it as planted eucalyptus and 0.3 hectares as outside mapped forest.

The loss could reflect harvesting or another cause; the data do not establish its cause or whether it involved permanent land-use change. An additional 0.4 hectares of loss occurred in smaller patches that were not counted as an event.
